update.releaseNotes:
Version 3.5.0.10 Release Notes:
✨ New Features: 🛠️ Complete System Overview & Architecture 1. Main Dashboard (Form2) — The Background Controller This serves as the silent heart of your backup system.
Automation: Uses a standard Timer component checking the system clock. It automatically packages and pushes backups twice a day at 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM.
Invisible Background Monitoring: When the close (X) or minimize button is clicked, instead of exiting, the window securely hides using a NotifyIcon. It moves to the Windows System Tray (beside the clock) with a notification bubble alert.
Restore to Screen: Admin can double-click the application icon in the system tray at any time to bring the control dashboard back to full view.
2. Send Backup Configuration (FormSendBackup) — The Uploader Path Management: Allows browsing and defining your local database workspace (e.g., C:\...\BAYBAY 2\ARS) and your cloud-synced Google Drive folder (e.g., G:\My Drive\ARSICS\BAYBAY).
Settings Persistence: Saves configurations permanently across app restarts using the .NET Framework 4.7.2 user settings subsystem (My.Settings.LocalFolderPath and My.Settings.DriveFolderPath).
Manual Backup Button: Allows the Admin to immediately trigger a manual ZIP compilation test on demand without waiting for the automated timer schedule.
Delete Path Button: Provides an optional clear utility with a safety confirmation prompt to instantly erase stored file paths from the system cache.
3. Receive Backup Recovery (FormReceiveBackup) — The Restorer Zip Extraction Loop: Implements an archive extraction protocol utilizing the System.IO.Compression library.
File Separation Security: The extractor selectively filters files inside the chosen backup archive, ensuring only .dbf extension files are handled and written to prevent directory clutter or data corruption.
On-Demand Location Overwrite: When Restore is executed, a FolderBrowserDialog allows the Admin to pinpoint exactly where they want to unpack the data, safely displaying a warning dialog before executing a hard overwrite of matching database tables.
Please update to access the new sales centers and benefit from improved robustness and error handling.
